_doc: Vocabulary-mismatch query suite — ISOLATED from the main keyword benchmark (test-queries.json) so it never dilutes baseline.json / the CI gate. Run (MUST pass --production-hybrid; the default FTS-only path AND-joins multi-word NL queries and scores ~0, which is a misleading artifact): node benchmark/benchmark.mjs --queries fixtures/test-queries-vocab-mismatch.json --production-hybrid. Baseline: benchmark/baseline-vocab-mismatch.json. Observed R@10 ~0.33 vs ~0.90 keyword (2026-06) — the gap is the real vocabulary-mismatch deficit. Each query reuses SEMANTIC ground-truth (relevant_ids audited against narrative, not keyword match); the query wording deliberately OMITS the concept headword that would be a trivial FTS hit, to measure recall when user words != memory words. Two tiers: vocab_mismatch_synonym (lexical variant) and vocab_mismatch_paraphrase (natural-language description). Built + audited 2026-06-21.

queries.desc: Kubernetes work phrased with the textbook category name
queries.rationale: Corpus uniformly says 'Kubernetes'/'EKS'/'pod'/'cluster'; 'orchestration' = 0 hits. Anchored to q25 but DROPPED #171 (Airflow workflow-orchestration, different sense).

queries.desc: Continuous-deployment / GitOps work phrased as 'release rollout'
queries.rationale: Tokens 'release'/'rollout' absent; corpus says 'deployment'/'GitOps'/'ArgoCD'/'canary'. Dropped q12's #88 (CI-secrets bug) & #171 (Airflow upgrade); added #54 (ArgoCD CD sync-loop bug).

queries.desc: WebSocket/SSE live-update work phrased as 'server push'
queries.rationale: 'push' absent; corpus says 'WebSocket'/'GraphQL subscriptions'/'broadcasts'/'SSE'. Anchored to q15 + extended with #140 (SSE), the canonical non-WebSocket server-push.

queries.desc: Kafka event-streaming work phrased with the generic 'message queue' category
queries.rationale: Headword 'Kafka' in all 4; 'message queue'/'queue'/'message' absent, and avoided 'broker'/'event bus' (present in #15/#63) to keep it a fair synonym. Reuses q2.

queries.desc: Terraform/Pulumi IaC work phrased as the 'infrastructure as code' category
queries.rationale: Headword 'Terraform'/'Pulumi'; 'declarative'/'cloud' absent, avoided literal 'infrastructure as code' (#199 only). Reuses q16.

queries.desc: Observability tooling phrased without the word 'observability'
queries.rationale: 'observability' literal only in #115; others say 'distributed tracing'/'monitoring alerts'/'Prometheus service discovery'. Excluded #136 (Kubecost/FinOps) & #73 (canary that adds a dashboard).

queries.query: the app crashed because it ran out of memory
queries.desc: Functional description of OOM / memory-exhaustion bugs
queries.rationale: Spelled-out 'ran out of memory' = 0 hits; corpus uses jargon 'OOM'/'OOMKilled'/'memory leak'. Excluded #20 (conn leak) & #107 (UI-thread freeze, not OOM).

queries.query: two operations happening at the same time corrupt or duplicate data
queries.desc: Functional description of concurrency / race-condition bugs
queries.rationale: Jargon 'race condition'/'concurrent'/'deadlock'/'mutex' absent from query (symptom described). Excluded #197 (pool exhaustion), #76 (flaky test), #159 (retry herd).

queries.query: how do I keep the app working when there is no internet connection?
queries.rationale: 'internet'/'no connection' absent; corpus says 'offline-first'/'WatermelonDB'/'regained connectivity'. Tight; excluded #124 (MMKV persistence) & #138 (React Query refetch). LOW cardinality (3, two near-dup).

queries.query: timestamps show the wrong time for users in different parts of the world
queries.rationale: Avoids headword 'timezone'/'UTC'. Tight pair; excluded #145 (SCD dates) & #167 (event-time watermark). LOW cardinality (2) — recall noisier here.

queries.query: stop users from submitting bad or malformed input
queries.rationale: Tighter than q8's heterogeneous set: only USER-input validation (#11 zod wizard, #60 req middleware, #98 upload, #175 anti-injection). Dropped Terraform/Parquet/data-contract 'validation'.

queries.query: the screen freezes and stutters when there is a lot of data
queries.desc: Functional description of UI-thread jank / frozen-UI performance bugs
queries.rationale: 'stutter' absent; corpus says 'fps drops'/'froze the UI'/'jank'. UI-responsiveness subset; excluded #163 (cold-start latency). Overlaps q9 on #2/#52/#174 but is the distinct UI-jank symptom.
